head.title: Before you travel
head.lede: What each trip includes, what you arrange and bring yourself, and the health and insurance details we need from every guest before booking.

essentials.title: Three things we need from every guest

responsibilities.title: What you are responsible for
responsibilities.intro: Each trip page lists what is included between its start and end points. These you arrange and bring yourself.

health.title: Health, insurance & medical information
health.intro: Many of our routes are remote, and the nearest hospital can be hours away, so we plan the pace and our emergency response around what you tell us.
health.notSure: Not sure whether a trip suits a health condition, an allergy or your mobility? Ask us before you book.
health.whatsappMessage: Hello Wildora, I have a health question before booking:

difficulty.title: Difficulty grades
difficulty.intro: Every trip page shows its grade. On a private departure we can set the pace around your group.
difficulty.none: No current fixed departure is graded {grade}. A private route can be, on request.

packing.title: What to pack
packing.intro: A general list for all our routes. Each <link>trip page</link> adds its own “What to bring” list for its season and terrain.

essential.title: Essential gear
items: Sturdy, broken-in walking shoes or boots with good grip
A rain jacket that is waterproof, not just water-resistant
Long trousers and full-sleeve shirts in neutral colours
A warm layer for early mornings and high ground
Headlamp or torch, with spare batteries

extras.title: Useful extras
items: Camera with a telephoto or macro lens, spare batteries and memory cards
Your own field guide (we carry shared references)
Power bank, and a plug adapter for Indian sockets (Types C, D and M; 230 V): power can be intermittent at remote lodges
Tissues, hand sanitiser and wet wipes for the road

included.title: What each trip includes
included.intro: We use wildlife lodges, guesthouses and nature stays chosen for comfort and for being close to the field. Meals are included on every trip; tell us about any allergy or dietary need when you book.
included.notIncludedBody: Travel medical insurance, and everything under <link>What you are responsible for</link>.
